verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform that holds sensitive company data, so whether customers can opt out of AI-model training is a fair privacy question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or any related privacy policy. The cited items cover cap tables, data rooms, workflows and pricing, and the probes found only 404s.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
